name: Personal data
privacy_notes: Personal identifiers require minimization and redaction.
recommended_handling: Redact before analysis and avoid saving raw text unless intentional.

name: Customer data
privacy_notes: Customer context can expose private or contractual information.
recommended_handling: Keep drafts local and require approval before external messages.

name: HR / candidate data
privacy_notes: Candidate data can affect employment opportunities.
recommended_handling: Require recruiter review and avoid automated decisions.

name: Financial data
privacy_notes: Financial workflows can affect money movement and accounting.
recommended_handling: Require authorized approval and audit trail.

name: Medical / health data
recommended_handling: Avoid processing unless reviewed by qualified staff.

name: Legal / compliance data
privacy_notes: Legal context may create obligations or liability.

name: Credentials or secrets
privacy_notes: Secrets must never be pasted into prompts or reports.
recommended_handling: Remove credentials and rotate if real exposure occurs.

name: Security event data
privacy_notes: Security context may drive response decisions.
recommended_handling: Require analyst review and no autonomous containment.

name: Location / logistics data
privacy_notes: Location data can identify people or operations.
recommended_handling: Minimize address details and require dispatcher review.

name: Business confidential data
privacy_notes: Internal business details may be sensitive.
recommended_handling: Keep local and limit report scope.
